subject: Merging legends with scale_x_manual (shape,colour) and math in legends

messages.author: cd8a02b90e537c02
messages.subject: Merging legends with scale_x_manual (shape,colour) and math in legends
parts:
Hello,

I'm having trouble convincing ggplot2 to merge the shape and colour
legends when using both geom_line() and geom_point() with the manual
scales. The problem arises because a) I have more than 6 line/point
combinations (although a single classification variable provides the
levels for both aesthetics) and b) I'd like to use expressions in
legend labels. A contrived example is presented below:

dat=data.frame(classname=c(rep("A",5),rep("B",
5)),x=rep(1:5,2),y=c(5+rnorm(5),3+rnorm(5)))

labs=c("C[A]","C[B]")

p = ggplot(dat,aes(x=x,y=y,colour=classname,shape=classname))
p+geom_line()+geom_point()
+scale_colour_manual(values=1:2,breaks=c("A","B"),labels=parse(text=labs))
+scale_shape_manual(values=1:2,breaks=c("A","B"),labels=parse(text=labs))

The legend appears as two separate entities, rather than being merged
into one that presents colour and shape simultaneously.

I've tried all sorts of different combinations such as including the
aesthetics in the geoms and not in the ggplot() statement, including
them in both and everything in between. Any suggestions on how to
make this work would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks,

Chris

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Merging legends with scale_x_manual (shape,colour) and math in legends
parts:
Hi:

Try this:

labs2 <- list(expression(C[A]), expression(C[B]))

p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x=x, y=y, colour=classname, shape=classname))
p + geom_line() + geom_point() +
scale_colour_manual(breaks = c('A', 'B'), values = 1:2,
labels = labs2) +
scale_shape_manual(breaks=c("A", "B"),
values = 1:2,
labels = labs2)

HTH,
Dennis
